notes: לַיהוָה → Jehovah's: possessive לְ rendered as an English genitive fuses with the name, headed on the lexeme (rule 49).
Waws rendered Then, even and for each take the word written (rule 14).
Supplied objects it and them are added (rule 44); עַד־כַּלֵּה → till thou have consumed gives subject and auxiliary to the infinitive absolute.
